Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misreported and swapped the birth years: it incorrectly cited P. J. O'Rourke’s birth as 1832 (instead of 1947) and José Echegaray y Eizaguirre’s as 1947 (instead of 1832), despite WebSurfer providing correct dates. This inversion led to the wrong conclusion about who was born first.
